samples.question: The figure shows one solid grey plate on white paper, cut all the way across by a single dark curve that has exactly one height at every horizontal position and runs past both ends of the plate. Only grey plate area counts: the dark curve's own pixels belong to neither side, and the small saturated coloured marks are decoration lying outside the plate. Grey plate area above the curve means grey lying higher than the curve at the same horizontal position; below means lower. Is there more grey plate area above the dark curve or below it? Answer with one word: above or below.
